title: Affine images away from the other closed member of a cover
statement: Let X be a reduced scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-pc-reduced-scheme], f:Y -> X a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], T a closed subset with range(f) union T = X, and V an affine open of Y whose image is disjoint from T. There is an affine open U of X whose carrier is exactly f(V). No reducedness of Y or finiteness hypotheses are needed.

source.place: Lemma 09NX, final paragraph: passing from the component affine locus disjoint from the other components to its ambient affine locus; the reduced closed-immersion argument is written out by C2

proof.text: Put W=X minus T. Every point of W lifts along f by the cover equality. Thus the restriction f|W is surjective. It is a closed immersion into the reduced scheme W, hence an isomorphism by Mathlib isIso_of_isClosedImmersion_of_surjective.

Disjointness gives V <= f^-1 W. Compose the open immersion V -> f^-1 W, the isomorphism f|W, and W -> X. Its source is affine, so its open image is affine by Mathlib IsAffineOpen.image_of_isOpenImmersion. The composite equals V.ι followed by f, and elementary image membership identifies its range with f(V).
